placements.title: Standardized first-week onboarding checklists replace static documentation to operationalize new hire integration
placements.frame: How does a structured first-week onboarding checklist establish operational readiness and consistent integration for new hires?
placements.why: Segment src-1 establishes the mandatory transition from a legacy wiki page to the structured Pallasine checklist governing accounts, pairing rotations, and shadow shifts during a new hire's first week.
